  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer loop : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.9)
    set burst := burstA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(loop, length)
    let b := taplin(loop, length + 1.0)
    let avg := (a + b) * 0.5
    let flip := select(lt(noise1(fract(seed * 3.7) * 8191.0), 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    let fb := min(0.9995, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    push loop := clip(avg * flip * fb + nz * burstA, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.8 * (avg - lp) * (0.6 + colour * 0.4)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.6136

dsp GenKsDrum0p7DarkTight where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer loop : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.9)
    set burst := burstA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(loop, length)
    let b := taplin(loop, length + 1.0)
    let avg := (a + b) * 0.5
    let flip := select(lt(noise1(fract(seed * 3.7) * 8191.0), 0.7), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    let fb := min(0.9995, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    push loop := clip(avg * flip * fb + nz * burstA, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.3 * (avg - lp) * (0.6 + colour * 0.4)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.0178

dsp GenKsDrum0p9BrightTight where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer loop : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.9)
    set burst := burstA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(loop, length)
    let b := taplin(loop, length + 1.0)
    let avg := (a + b) * 0.5
    let flip := select(lt(noise1(fract(seed * 3.7) * 8191.0), 0.9), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    let fb := min(0.9995, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    push loop := clip(avg * flip * fb + nz * burstA, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.8 * (avg - lp) * (0.6 + colour * 0.4)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5340

hopPentatonic4Sine.source:
dsp GenHopPentatonic4Sine where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state clk : F32 := 0.0
  state step : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let clkA := fract(clk + 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) / sr)
    let tick := lt(clkA, clk)
    set clk := clkA
    let stepA := select(tick, (noise1(seed * 977.0) * 5.0 * 0.999 - fract(noise1(seed * 977.0) * 5.0 * 0.999)), step)
    set step := stepA
    let semis := select(lt(stepA, 0.5), 0.0, select(lt(stepA, 1.5), 3.0, select(lt(stepA, 2.5), 5.0, select(lt(stepA, 3.5), 7.0, 10.0))))
    let ratio := expneg(semis * (0.0 - 0.05776227))
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * ratio / sr))
    let peA := select(tick, 1.0, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.5 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(ph * 2.0) * envA * (0.6 + peA * 0.4)) * 0.8) * 0.6367

hopPentatonic8Pluck.source:
dsp GenHopPentatonic8Pluck where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state clk : F32 := 0.0
  state step : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let clkA := fract(clk + 8.0 * (0.5 + colour) / sr)
    let tick := lt(clkA, clk)
    set clk := clkA
    let stepA := select(tick, (noise1(seed * 977.0) * 5.0 * 0.999 - fract(noise1(seed * 977.0) * 5.0 * 0.999)), step)
    set step := stepA
    let semis := select(lt(stepA, 0.5), 0.0, select(lt(stepA, 1.5), 3.0, select(lt(stepA, 2.5), 5.0, select(lt(stepA, 3.5), 7.0, 10.0))))
    let ratio := expneg(semis * (0.0 - 0.05776227))
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * ratio / sr))
    let peA := select(tick, 1.0, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.075 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(ph * 2.0) * envA * peA) * 0.8) * 0.7720

hopPentatonic13Sine.source:
dsp GenHopPentatonic13Sine where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state clk : F32 := 0.0
  state step : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let clkA := fract(clk + 13.0 * (0.5 + colour) / sr)
    let tick := lt(clkA, clk)
    set clk := clkA
    let stepA := select(tick, (noise1(seed * 977.0) * 5.0 * 0.999 - fract(noise1(seed * 977.0) * 5.0 * 0.999)), step)
    set step := stepA
    let semis := select(lt(stepA, 0.5), 0.0, select(lt(stepA, 1.5), 3.0, select(lt(stepA, 2.5), 5.0, select(lt(stepA, 3.5), 7.0, 10.0))))
    let ratio := expneg(semis * (0.0 - 0.05776227))
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * ratio / sr))
    let peA := select(tick, 1.0, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.153846 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(ph * 2.0) * envA * (0.6 + peA * 0.4)) * 0.8) * 0.6467

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31

    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0

    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs

    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate

dsp GenComb0p9HissSwell where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let exc := nz
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.9, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5512

dsp GenComb0p9CrackleSwell where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let crackA := select(gt(nz, 0.97), nz, crack * 0.6)
    set crack := crackA
    let exc := crackA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.9, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

comb0p9CrackleStrike.source:
dsp GenComb0p9CrackleStrike where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let crackA := select(gt(nz, 0.97), nz, crack * 0.6)
    set crack := crackA
    let exc := crackA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.9, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

dsp GenComb0p9RumbleStrike where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let crackA := crack + 0.02 * (nz - crack)
    set crack := crackA
    let exc := crackA * 4.0
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.9, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.5767

dsp GenComb0p97HissHeld where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.02 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let exc := nz
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.97, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.8466

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.02 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let crackA := select(gt(nz, 0.97), nz, crack * 0.6)
    set crack := crackA
    let exc := crackA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.97, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.3402

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let crackA := select(gt(nz, 0.97), nz, crack * 0.6)
    set crack := crackA
    let exc := crackA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.97, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.3460

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let crackA := crack + 0.02 * (nz - crack)
    set crack := crackA
    let exc := crackA * 4.0
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.97, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4210

dsp GenComb0p97RumbleStrike where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let crackA := crack + 0.02 * (nz - crack)
    set crack := crackA
    let exc := crackA * 4.0
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.97, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.5766

  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0

  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0

    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.9173

dsp GenComb0p995HissStrike where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let exc := nz
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.995, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7156

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.02 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let crackA := crack + 0.02 * (nz - crack)
    set crack := crackA
    let exc := crackA * 4.0
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.995, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7367

dsp GenComb0p995RumbleSwell where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let crackA := crack + 0.02 * (nz - crack)
    set crack := crackA
    let exc := crackA * 4.0
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(comb, length)
    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.995, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.1555

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer comb : F32[4096]

    let lpA := lp + (0.3 + colour * 0.6) * (a - lp)

    push comb := clip(exc * envA * 0.3 + lpA * 0.995, -1.5, 1.5)
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.0
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.5765

dsp GenBell02 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.750017 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.165 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 2.382 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.9), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.454545 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 6.184 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A) * 0.25) * 1.0042

dsp GenBell03 where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 4.091067 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.666667 * (1.0 + colour * 0.3), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.714286 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.887 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.6), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.555556 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 7.734 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A) * 0.288675) * 1.0507
